levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن إسحاق القاضي

notes: «سمعت جابر بن سمرة يقول: سمعت رسول الله» — the Companion is the last link, the Prophet is the end
the first-person continuation («فأتيته ... فقلت») is Jabir's own speech and the chain ends at him: no ruling needed
the sources' chains for this saying are variants (corr1-corr3): not used as readings
